[{"id": "2035569332655928843", "text": "You launch a campaign, spend money for a few weeks, and then someone asks, "Is it working?"

And you realize you're not sure how to answer that question.

This happens to small businesses all the time. The campaign is running, money is being spent, but nobody defined what success looks like before they started. So now you're guessing based on gut feel instead of measuring based on data.

The fix is simple but easy to skip: decide how you'll measure success before you launch. Are you tracking online sales? Form submissions? Phone calls? Even website engagement can tell you something useful if you know what to look for.

Not every campaign leads directly to a sale either, and that's fine. Some campaigns build awareness. Some drive traffic that converts later. The key is knowing which type of campaign you're running and measuring it accordingly.

Our latest article breaks down 9 specific methods for measuring digital marketing success, split between direct conversions and website behavior metrics. 📊", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMUCZWIaFTeVOswoB07ucHwyW07zL2VqaCsUi8S=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.mainstreetroi.com/9-ways-to-measure-digital-marketing-success/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-21T15:00:51", "expires_at": "2027-03-23T15:00:49", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "5165227067858879359", "text": "Do you think it's worth sending an email to a list of 45 people?

Most business owners would say no. It feels too small to matter.

One of our clients, a chiropractor, had exactly 45 prospective patients on their list. We sent a simple 3-part email sequence promoting a first-time patient offer. Plain text emails, nothing fancy.

The result was just over $1,000 in new business. From 45 contacts.

We see the same pattern with cold lists too. Another client had 14,000 customers they hadn't emailed in over two years. The list felt worthless. We ran a short warm-up sequence to re-introduce the brand, let people opt out if they wanted, and then sent a simple promotion.

That campaign generated over $20,000 in sales.

The point isn't the specific numbers. It's that most businesses are sitting on an email list right now that they've written off as too small or too inactive to use. Our latest article walks through both of these case studies and what you can learn from them. 📧", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMYAnzlhHx-ys5iUkXcgL5U1t3ZApj50vk4YjKd=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.mainstreetroi.com/2-email-marketing-case-studies-that-prove-no-list-is-too-small-or-too-cold/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-18T15:00:39", "expires_at": "2027-03-20T15:00:37", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "6732304730386559830", "text": "Getting started on Google Ads takes about 15 minutes. Google has made it incredibly easy. A few clicks, a credit card, and your ads are live.

Getting results from Google Ads? That's a different story.

The gap between "I'm running ads" and "I'm getting leads and sales from my ads" is where most small businesses get stuck. And the challenges aren't always obvious until you're already spending money.

Things like choosing keywords that attract tire kickers instead of buyers. Sending ad traffic to your homepage instead of a targeted landing page. Running campaigns without conversion tracking, so you have no idea which ads are actually working.

None of these are hard to fix once you know what to look for. But if you don't know to look for them, they'll quietly drain your budget month after month.

Our latest article walks through 10 of the most common Google Ads challenges small businesses face and how to get past each one. 💡", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipNjp0d1Sw7z0PBvWRLfZ7a6W5CFq7PX4MjJZaVO=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.mainstreetroi.com/10-adwords-challenges-for-small-businesses-and-how-to-overcome-them/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-14T15:01:27", "expires_at": "2027-03-16T15:01:26", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "2104654318594811881", "text": "There's no "one trick" that made this Google Ads campaign 33% cheaper per lead.

I know that's not the headline most people want to hear. We all want the silver bullet. The one change that fixes everything.

But that's not how Google Ads optimization actually works.

This case study is a dentist in Georgia who came to us advertising on his own with no conversion tracking. He didn't know which campaigns were working, which keywords were driving calls, or where his budget was being wasted.

We started by setting up proper tracking. Then, over several months, we made continuous improvements across the entire account: ad scheduling, device bids, budget allocation across campaigns, keyword-level adjustments, and ad copy testing.

No single change was the breakthrough. But added together, month after month, cost per lead dropped from $48 to $32. With the same quarterly budget, that's 51 more leads every quarter.

The Japanese call this Kaizen: continuous improvement. It's not flashy, but it works. 📉", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPAc6lm5UF0V4mNlNAdqIe0szYwLvkInvSyL4z2=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.mainstreetroi.com/adwords-case-study-33-reduction-in-cost-per-lead-using-the-kaizen-approach/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-07T18:00:33", "expires_at": "2027-03-09T18:00:31", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "4303502869396311320", "text": "You've gotten those LinkedIn messages from companies you've never heard of, asking for 15 minutes of your time. You probably ignored it.

Now think about the last time you got a message from someone whose posts you'd actually been reading for a few weeks. Same message format, completely different reaction.

That gap between "delete" and "actually read it" is the core problem with how most businesses run LinkedIn Ads. They pick one approach: either cold messages that get ignored, or feed content that builds visibility but never converts into a real conversation.

Over the past couple of years running LinkedIn Ads campaigns, we found that the best results come from running both at the same time. The feed builds familiarity. The message starts the conversation. And when both tracks run together, they make each other work harder.

We wrote a new article introducing The Dual Track Approach, the strategy behind running feed ads and message ads as one coordinated system instead of two separate campaigns. 💬", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipNLhHNab6OR6vyA5gwPWTJnNZ9JDmix-o1LEizS=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.mainstreetroi.com/dual-track-approach-linkedin-ads/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-04T14:00:43", "expires_at": "2027-03-06T14:00:41", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "3367415208038619706", "text": "If you run a local business, when was the last time you actually checked your Google Business Profile?

We do SEO audits regularly, and nearly 100% of the businesses we review are making at least one of the mistakes in this article. Usually more than one.

The good news is most of them are easy to fix once you know what to look for. Things like missing categories on your Google Business Profile, inconsistent contact information across directories, or a website with thin content that isn't giving Google enough to work with.

Some of these take 20 minutes to fix. Others take a longer investment. But all of them are costing you visibility in local search results right now.

A print ad, a mailer, a sponsorship, a radio spot.

And when we ask how it went, the answer is almost always the same: "I think we got a few calls from it, but I'm not really sure."

That uncertainty is one of the biggest reasons to shift your marketing budget online. With digital marketing, you can see exactly what's working and what isn't. You can track which campaigns are driving leads, which emails are generating sales, and which pages on your website are converting visitors into customers.

That doesn't mean every digital channel will work for every business. But it does mean you'll know, and you can adjust based on real data instead of gut feel.

A few clicks, let the AI handle the targeting, the copy, the bidding. It sounds great.

But have you noticed that the easier these platforms get, the harder it is to see what's actually happening inside your campaigns?

[{"id": "6647300026242754617", "text": "For years, marketers measured visibility by tracking Google rankings.

Today, buyers are asking ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and AI Overviews who to hire and what to buy.

The challenge? Traditional SEO tools can't tell you whether your brand is part of those AI-generated answers.

That's why we launched Rankxa, a platform that helps businesses measure and improve their visibility across AI search.

Because the future of search isn't just about rankings. It's about recommendations.

Read the full announcement published by EIN Presswire:
", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMUU10XzxMYq0jMRogWB_PmvF54kNO3KRd8EEB8=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-07-02T16:01:45", "expires_at": "2027-01-01T16:01:43", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "188662402504203921", "text": "More impressions don't always mean more growth ❌

Neither do more clicks, followers, or website traffic.

A campaign can look great on paper and still fail to drive revenue.

That's why we focus less on vanity metrics and more on what actually impacts performance:
✔️ Conversion rates
✔️ Qualified leads
✔️ Lower acquisition costs
✔️ Customer retention
✔️ Scalable systems

Because visibility means nothing if it doesn't turn into business growth.

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMz055-k47sWys021Dl3keXYDhTOWXlBkRaD2-j=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-06-24T16:02:01", "expires_at": "2026-12-24T16:01:59", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "4240186385678984318", "text": "The brands winning in 2026 aren't guessing.

They're testing.
👉 Fixing.
👉 Learning.
👉 Iterating.
👉 Repeating.

Not because it sounds good, but because it's the only way performance actually improves.

There's no "perfect" campaign that changes everything overnight.

Just small decisions, made consistently, that compound over time.

That's how we approach marketing at BusySeed.

Less guesswork. More systems that get sharper every week.

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipOHEZ2Wc6PM8pGyuGAw4azjyCuiBU1dLv3bKOlC=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-06-17T16:02:31", "expires_at": "2026-12-17T16:02:28", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "6240578054571937712", "text": "AI can scale your content.

But it can also make your brand sound like everyone else.

The brands winning in 2026 aren't using AI to replace their voice. They're using it to scale smarter without losing what makes them recognizable.

This blog breaks down how to balance automation with authenticity.

Read it here 👇
", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipP3W-N69jxuikn5k8Ox71ZRz9PmHexI46YU6ru6=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-06-10T16:02:48", "expires_at": "2026-12-10T16:02:44", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "218089920976615219", "text": "Virality is not a strategy.

It's unpredictable, temporary, and rarely repeatable.

What actually drives performance is the work most people don't post about:
• Testing creatives until patterns emerge
• Fixing landing pages that quietly kill conversions
• Refining targeting based on real data, not assumptions
• Improving systems week after week

That's why at BusySeed, we focus on performance over moments and systems over shortcuts.

Because what you practice is what scales. 

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPbNCusADIjkwisRXVywKxRBc5rtu5fejL5_Wau=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-06-03T16:02:21", "expires_at": "2026-12-03T16:02:11", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "90811641329916635", "text": "Marketing in 2026 isn’t about tools.

It’s about systems.

Most brands stack tools. We build a connected growth engine. Each piece of proprietary tech, from SeedLanding to SeedGEO, shares data, learns from performance, and makes your marketing:
✔️ smarter
✔️ faster
✔️ and self-optimizing

That’s why our clients don’t just run campaigns.
They run results.

Take your business to the next level with our tools 👇
", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipNeLvuOVKfj_tZUTy6Qyr_hqVzk98QAP5hImemf=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-05-27T16:02:59", "expires_at": "2026-11-26T16:02:56", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "2725417356507827685", "text": "Everyone’s talking about AI search, social search, and the “death of Google”.

But Google organic still drives some of the highest-intent traffic you can get.

The difference is how it’s used. It’s no longer a standalone channel. It:
👉 Feeds your data
👉 Strengthens your targeting
👉 Powers a connected growth system across every platform

Ignore it, and you don’t just lose rankings. You lose signal.

This blog breaks down how to use Google SEO effectively in 2026.

Read it here 👇 
", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMH7lBu3V-GdG4wxT1gMCSg8VE1qIT6oRrHyYVS=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-05-20T16:03:59", "expires_at": "2026-11-19T16:03:56", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "3132156382974153629", "text": "Your ads can be perfect, but if your landing page isn’t personalized, your CPL will spike.

SeedLanding doesn’t just host pages. 

It adapts in real time for each visitor: 
✔️ Dynamic headlines 
✔️ Personalized images 
✔️ Optimized CTAs 
✔️ Tailored forms based on behavior

Every page guides visitors toward action, boosting engagement and conversions without any coding.

Marketing isn’t magic. It’s engineered for results.

Check it out → ", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipOTBalAcEb1l3-U368e2Q8R2d4PI2qj4zLFDV_8=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-05-13T16:04:35", "expires_at": "2026-11-12T16:04:31", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "8852707826662463472", "text": "Not all clicks are equal.

Some campaigns drive traffic. Others drive revenue.

SeedGEO Revenue predicts how much revenue each channel, campaign, and audience can actually generate. Paired with our proprietary AI, it turns guesswork into measurable growth.

Stop guessing. Start growing! 👇
", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPYiQoeZV-6yJNjIFbatMUR7Bk8FOsT7RMVdSD-=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-05-06T16:02:57", "expires_at": "2026-11-05T16:02:53", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "944585040939383967", "text": "Stop guessing where your audience is.

Different platforms = different intent.
You don't need to be everywhere. You need to be where it counts.

Here’s where your budget actually works:

👉 Google Ads: High intent. They're actively searching for a solution. Be the answer.
👉 Meta (FB/IG): Discovery mode. They don't know they need you yet; your creative makes them stop.
👉 LinkedIn: The trust engine. Authority first, conversion second. Built for high-value B2B.
👉 TikTok / Shorts: Attention at scale. Fast, immersive content that builds awareness and educates quickly.

At BusySeed, we don't pick platforms at random.
We align your goals with how each algorithm actually works.

Because when strategy matches intent,
Your budget doesn’t just spend, it performs.

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipN6ZUtjcTJFgAPk_mz6QSjdDCdt5Rhcy2mTkIeu=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-04-29T16:03:30", "expires_at": "2026-10-29T16:03:28", "promo_code": null}]

The upcoming summer months of June through August are by far the most popular time of the year, as kids are off from school and the days are warmer and longer (at least here in the Northern Hemisphere).

There is no shortage of companies or services that help make traveling easier, and many of the newer ones have some great names that evoke curiosity and the spirit of getting away. River + Wolf has a few of our favorite names in the travel and hospitality industries - click the link below to check them out. ", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPPbkdNYHf3943pqF5099hNRURpqSuOWnXhREur=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://bit.ly/3ViNFZE", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2025-04-29T13:00:23", "expires_at": "2025-10-29T13:00:21", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "5085878161628957430", "text": "Noted American writer and instructor Gary Provost famously said, "Don't just write words. Just as writers use varying sentence lengths and repetition to create flow and interest, brand namers tap into the musicality of language to make names memorable and emotionally resonant. Poetic tools in the namer's toolbox include such devices as alliteration (repeating consonant sounds), assonance (repeating vowel sounds), and even hard or soft rhymes. All of these things can give a name staying power and instant appeal.

At River + Wolf, we believe names should not only communicate--they should sing. Click the link below to learn more and see how River + Wolf approaches our naming efforts to ensure the final naming product truly sings.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMU4NEnPOcxvgHppW_NpVr7sY1VdB8GgycOz-Vb=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://bit.ly/3Gb3Lk1", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2025-04-22T13:00:24", "expires_at": "2025-10-22T13:00:23", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "8333117297433310898", "text": "Tea is second to only water in terms of the most-consumed beverage in the world. It is enjoyed in nearly every country, and according to the World Tea Association, a whopping three billion cups of tea are consumed every single day.

When the founders of a new herbal tea approached River + Wolf for a name for their new organization, they wanted something memorable that also gave a nod to their Indonesian heritage. After steeping ourselves (pun intended) in the region and their cultural traditions, we came up with Ikaati, a play on ikat (an Indonesian dyeing technique) and kati (caddy), which is a traditional vessel used for transporting tea.

We were happy with what we brewed up, and so was Ikaati - click the link below to learn more about this particular naming venture and browse our other work.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipO6o7HbzvE13hHXB5WENWk_QmUKJBhIoQHmZuJZ=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://bit.ly/44mudRy", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2025-04-18T13:00:06", "expires_at": "2025-10-18T13:00:04", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "6395075805490755860", "text": "Second only to water, tea is the most sipped and savored beverage across the globe. From sunlit verandas to bustling city corners, it's a ritual shared by nearly every culture. According to the World Tea Association, a staggering three billion cups are poured and enjoyed each day.

So when the founders of a new herbal tea line came to River + Wolf in search of a name, they asked for something unforgettable--something that would honor their Indonesian roots while capturing the essence of their brand.

We immersed ourselves--steeped, if you will--in the rich heritage and traditions of the region. The result was Ikaati, a name that blends ikat, the intricate Indonesian dyeing technique, with kati, a nod to the classic tea caddy once used to transport the treasured leaves.

We were delighted with what we brewed up--and so was Ikaati. Click the link below to explore this naming journey and discover more of our work.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipNHUOeTCIpFsKE5dH63KqxKwdbk56AXtbJb8HWm=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://bit.ly/44mudRy", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2025-04-16T13:00:06", "expires_at": "2025-10-16T13:00:04", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "2182035313494794877", "text": ""Because of this project, our brand is getting positive feedback in the Kenyan market and seeing an increase in customer activity. They go above and beyond to ensure the customer's needs are met. Their personalized service, prompt feedback, and attention to detail sets them apart. They were excellent." - Abdi Abdirizak, CEO of Medallo Energy

Abdi's glowing testimonial is just one of the numerous five-star reviews River + Wolf has proudly received from clients we were able to help with their branding and naming needs. If your organization is looking to name a new product or business, our creative team can help you land on a meaningful moniker - click the link below to learn more. ", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipP09YH6OyADhCJCjcFm1WYFSgTKWwf_mD5kUKd7=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://bit.ly/3YaO01m", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2025-04-13T22:20:03", "expires_at": "2025-10-13T22:20:02", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "6142474223748915962", "text": "Spring is here, which for many of us means it's the time of year when we spend more time on grooming and personal care. Summer is just around the corner, meaning that longer days and warmer weather will make more revealing attire a necessity.

For the April edition of our Names of Distinction (NOD), River + Wolf takes a look at some of our favorite brand names in the booming personal care industry. From hair care and shaving products to everything in between, we have selected some of the more innovative and creative names and have provided context on what makes them stand out. Click the link below to see for yourself and we hope you enjoy reading them as much as we enjoyed putting this list together. ", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipM6x5y-pgblDg5_BovMlty6YyAtytCaI9e4_Bps=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://bit.ly/47CoO7N", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2025-04-13T22:15:03", "expires_at": "2025-10-13T22:15:01", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "5018855098491655519", "text": "You've likely heard of, or even participated in, focus groups, which have long provided companies with insights into potential public reception of new products or services.

[{"id": "1789115256781535803", "text": "We're excited to announce that MuteSix is now a part of Lunar Solar Group and are happy to introduce our new CEO, Pierson Krass.

The acquisition of MuteSix by Lunar Solar Group marks a significant milestone in the journeys of both companies, promising to unlock new synergies, expanded capabilities, and accelerated strategy and technology innovation. If you’re new to Lunar, we’re a growth consultancy, technology studio, and full-service digital marketing agency. 

At Lunar, we give our partners an edge over the competition by not just leveraging the best technology and newest strategies but by pushing the industry forward. Our tools and strategies are leveraged by 5,000+ brands and hundreds of agency and technology partners. MuteSix’s team brings significant production capabilities, TikTok expertise, and depth of programmatic expertise that will undoubtedly benefit Lunar’s current partners. The combined expertise of both teams will enable the delivery of more integrated and effective solutions, addressing complex business challenges with a holistic approach. Clients can look forward to enhanced strategic insights, innovative solutions, and a seamless experience across the full spectrum of services. 

If you’re a MuteSix client, team member, or partner, we’re excited to welcome you to the Lunar ecosystem and look forward to helping you achieve your goals and Grow Beyond.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMrcATu43d35RqI2r6c_TeLKgBEaAUVEqPu2Z7v=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://lunarsolargroup.com/lunar-acquires-mutesix/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2025-02-10T17:11:32", "expires_at": "2025-08-12T17:11:32", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "2836361857441742814", "text": "Dentsu Inc. has agreed to acquire the direct-to-consumer marketing agency MuteSix, as the agency holding company looks to forge new relationships with emerging brands.

“I see this as being a way to diversify our client base, but not just diversify with clients that always have to have these enormous budgets,” said Jeremy Cornfeldt, chief executive at Dentsu digital agency iProspect, which will house the acquisition.

The idea is that when the shop’s smaller clients gain traction, they can plug into Dentsu’s agency network and consider marketing their brands beyond just social media, he said.

Japanese ad holding company Dentsu owns media agency Carat and marketing shop 360i, among other large agencies.

Direct-to-consumer brands that don’t rely on retailers to sell their products, at least at first, are increasingly popular and have leaned heavily on digital platforms like Facebook and Google to raise awareness. Madison Avenue is racing to get a piece of the action as many of these companies mature and expand their marketing budgets.

Agencies are also looking to diversify their client rosters as many advertiser clients cut back on agency fees or push their shops to create online ads more efficiently.

Los Angeles-based MuteSix touts about 120 employees and 270 clients, many of which are smaller than iProspect’s clients, said Mr. Cornfeldt.

The four-year-old shop’s revenue in 2018 was around $17 million, according to a person familiar with the matter.", "type": "update", "image": null, "title": null, "cta_url": "https://blog.mutesix.com/mutesix-was-acquired-by-dentsu-aegis-network", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2019-10-16T20:05:29", "expires_at": "2020-04-16T20:05:29", "promo_code": null}]

[{"id": "8795281135972203618", "text": "In the ever-evolving landscape of digital real estate marketing, where buyer/renter journeys span across diverse devices and platforms, harnessing the power of precise analytics is a game-changer. While Google Analytics has long been a staple for tracking website performance, the introduction of Google Analytics 4 (GA4) marks a new era of measurement and analysis. This upgrade is designed to scale with businesses and navigate the intricate web of user interactions, all while harnessing the potential of machine learning for predictive insights.

Adapting to the Multidevice User Journey
Purchasing or renting a home is a huge decision. As potential renters and buyers research their next home and switch between devices such as smartphones, tablets, and desktops, GA4 can eliminate duplicate user entries across devices, offering a unified insight into each individual. This comprehensive view enables marketers to develop customized approaches that effectively connect with audiences at every interaction point. 

GA4 steps up by ensuring that no interaction goes unnoticed. By intelligently deduplicating users across data from different devices, GA4 offers a cohesive view of a single user's journey, giving marketers the ability to tailor their strategies with precision.

Learn more at the link below!", "type": "event", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPYyZbBeBeEAAUm4annB6WQptqwhCT49WtNuqGe=h400-no", "title": "Revolutionizing Real Estate Insights with GA4", "cta_url": "https://kbpark.com/revolutionizing-real-estate-insights-with-google-analytics-4/?utm_source=google&utm_medium=gbp&utm_campaign=post", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2023-09-05T20:59:55", "expires_at": "2023-09-13T03:59:59", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "3983869915726392589", "text": "Central Park Tower (CPT) was bound to make an impact. It’s the tallest residential building in the world, and it borders Central Park, one of the most famous green spaces on the planet. 

Architectural Digest wrote that CPT “raises the bar of luxury to conjure a vision of the highest of high-end swank.” They also called CPT’s interiors “sumptuous yet exquisitely tailored” and Central Park Club’s interiors “fluid, though cohesive.” 

The club in question is—get ready for another record—the highest private club in the world and spans 50,000 square feet spread over three floors. It includes a 60-ft outdoor swimming pool, a screening room, a high-end fitness center and spa, a private park, a cabana deck, a billiards lounge, a wine and cigar lounge, and a bar and restaurant with world-renowned chefs in charge of the menu. As the Wall Street Journal reported, “For the club’s private restaurant, a trio of Michelin-starred chefs—Laurent Tourondel, Gabriel Kreuther, and Alfred Portale—have been selected to design a menu which Colin Cowie, a celebrity party planner and the building’s lifestyle coordinator, described as ‘Mediterranean, with subtle French and Italian undertones.’”

Learn more at the link below!", "type": "event", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipN2kGYOSUPkvFuxP6wYjpq-eD5KqaHMMrT7ZmU1=h400-no", "title": "See What Makes New York’s Central Park Tower so Newsworthy", "cta_url": "https://kbpark.com/what-makes-new-yorks-central-park-tower-so-newsworthy-see-what-these-publications-had-to-say/?utm_source=google&utm_medium=gbp&utm_campaign=blog_cpt_press-summary_3.24.23", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2023-03-24T16:41:28", "expires_at": "2023-04-08T03:59:59", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "6339307473628805284", "text": "In many ways, One Manhattan Square—and its staggering 100,000 square feet of amenities—reflects the manifold metropolis that surrounds it. Whether it’s fitness, relaxation, entertainment, or some combination, you’ll find it all right here at home. 

The Lower East Side condos at One Manhattan Square feature the largest private outdoor garden in the entire city. Spanning over an acre, the area is a sprawling oasis, an exquisite and thoughtfully designed respite from the din of New York. There are nooks dedicated to relaxation, such as the birch garden and the tea pavilion, as well as ping-pong tables, a putting green, fire pits, a herb garden, a Wi-Fi-equipped treehouse, a playground, grilling areas, and an observatory built for stargazing. Crafted by the landscape design legends at West 8, the space represents a refined mix of serene, active, and functional.

Leaning into the active, let’s talk squash. One Manhattan Square has access to a private squash court right in the building. Aside from the sports—and the water—there are four multiuse fitness areas, cardio and weights rooms, as well as a spin studio, a yoga studio, and a dance studio. 

Be sure to click the link below to read our full post and follow us for more information about the buildings—and the amenities—that are redefining luxury real estate in the world’s foremost markets.", "type": "event", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipNjKnZ9VRNVBMqeCbXT37tDxDe33pMdsUc9hrhH=h400-no", "title": "One Manhattan Square’s Amenity Spaces Redefine Luxury", "cta_url": "https://kbpark.com/one-manhattan-squares-amenity-spaces-are-redefining-the-future-of-luxury-living/?utm_source=google&utm_medium=gbp&utm_campaign=blog_oms_amenities_3.7.23", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2023-03-07T18:09:31", "expires_at": "2023-03-22T03:59:59", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "2432956945410363272", "text": "Repurposing Nature’s Artistry 

With Earth Day coming up on the 22nd, we’re taking the month of April to celebrate the union of architecture and environment, starting with a fresh look at some recent buildings that echo some of nature’s structures. Architects around the world have incorporated organic design elements into their buildings, with everything from a bird’s nest to microscopic organisms finding themselves reflected in stone and glass. One of the most famous examples of nature-inspired architecture is the Beijing National Stadium, designed by Herzog & de Meuron for the 2008 Olympics in Beijing. Replicating the bowl created by the tangled branches of a bird’s nest, the Beijing National Stadium takes the logic of the natural world and expands it to a vast human scale, making tiny nestlings of everyone who walks into the venue to enjoy an athletic contest. Read More at the link.", "type": "event", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipOqJUDWhsFZ8_LIipgA2wRvdgnvuoz7WCr98CSc=h400-no", "title": "Repurposing Nature's Artistry", "cta_url": "https://kbpark.com/repurposing-natures-artistry/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2022-04-06T14:26:27", "expires_at": "2022-05-01T03:59:59", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "6420634018018150581", "text": "A famous adage says that when it comes to communication, “the medium is more important than the message itself.” And while we at Knightsbridge Park believe in the power of language to emotionally connect users, there is something to be said about the efficacy of a new medium that every marketer needs to know about: Instant Experience Ads. In short, Instant Experience Ads are mobile-only ads that are designed to encourage in-platform engagement on social media. Why Use Them?
For real estate marketers, Instant Experience Ads are a great way to showcase the differentiating features of your property, drive traffic to your main site, and capture leads.

 What Exactly Is the Metaverse?

[{"id": "1641186576198467799", "text": "Your phone rings. Now you know exactly why.

We capture every inbound call, transcribe it, and trace it back to the campaign, keyword, and ad that made the phone ring. You get a plain summary of what the caller actually wanted, plus scoring that tells you which conversations were real opportunities and which were just curiosity.

Those calls then sit in Atrilyx next to every other channel, and get reconciled against your CRM and the revenue you actually closed.

Because 50 calls that book 45 jobs beat 200 calls that book 20.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipNsrNT9k6t5tvHbBLZFMS-8rgaNZNBc1YFLonIz=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.aimediagroup.com/services/phone-call-attribution", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-19T22:48:21", "expires_at": "2027-03-21T22:48:19", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "3107017768211707267", "text": "Know exactly what your social budget is driving.

Atrilyx reconciles every touchpoint against the full customer journey, so the channel that started the journey gets credit for the conversion it influenced. Our AI Agent tracks creative and audience shifts in real time, surfacing what changed well before a weekly report would.

See how we run paid social, and the results behind it.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipNUV0WhU1pGd-9kY_FR_c8Fi4AxnfFXMriikJj7=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.aimediagroup.com/services/paid-social", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-18T06:12:05", "expires_at": "2027-03-20T06:12:03", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "3378176119679512075", "text": "A full-funnel marketing strategy reaches audiences at every stage of the customer journey.

Programmatic advertising introduces your brand to highly targeted audiences and builds awareness early. Paid social nurtures those relationships where audiences already spend their time. Paid search connects with users actively seeking solutions. SEO creates lasting digital assets that continue delivering value long after content is published.

Together, these channels form a complete marketing ecosystem. Each one contributes insights that strengthen the whole — audience intelligence, engagement signals, intent-driven behaviors, and search trends analyzed as a connected picture.

Ai Media Group helps organizations in healthcare, education, hospitality, real estate, and retail build strategies that drive awareness, engagement, conversions, and long-term growth.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPMXvxX35yugEgnTU6V_TYxpobp3cVSLzP-lLsz=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.aimediagroup.com/perspectives/why-a-full-funnel-marketing-strategy-delivers-better-results", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-08-16T00:19:08", "expires_at": "2027-02-15T00:19:07", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "1787249833806992217", "text": "Programmatic, Held to the Same Attribution Truth as Every Other Channel

Programmatic is where upper-funnel influence is often hardest to measure clearly. A user served a display, native, audio, or video impression may return later through search, direct traffic, a phone call, or retargeting before converting — and without stitching that impression data into the attribution layer, programmatic's contribution stays invisible or gets misread.

We run programmatic across display, native, audio, and video with Atrilyx underneath, connecting every impression to the customer journey it actually influenced. When programmatic is driving downstream conversion behavior, the data shows it. When it isn't, the budget moves.

Know exactly what your programmatic budget is actually driving. Talk to us.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPRHnygJk5-7t893lS66XFhMGra-Blp4uaLfDj3=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.aimediagroup.com/services/programmatic", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-08-15T04:51:59", "expires_at": "2027-02-14T04:51:57", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "5024264154503721355", "text": "Reach the right audiences on the platforms that matter — Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, and more.

[{"id": "3612367181461179415", "text": "Twenty-nine impressions a month. Not a single inbound call from search. A Kips Bay marketing agency had been running campaigns for clients across New York while their own Google Business Profile sat completely dead.

They had been looking for SEO services that would actually surface their profile in local search results - and getting nothing from what they already had in place.

The profile looked fine on the surface. Photos uploaded. Business hours filled in. A handful of solid reviews. But the primary category was misaligned, the service area entries were incomplete, and the profile had gone unoptimized for close to six months. Google had no clean signal to work with.

Before: 29 impressions a month. Ranking on page 3 for the exact terms their ideal clients were typing. Zero calls traced to search in the previous 90 days.

After: impressions climbed to 740 within three weeks of the fix. Calls from search went from zero to six in the first full week of ranking movement. Page 1 placement for three core service terms, serving New York, NY and the surrounding metro.

The profile didn't need a rebuild. It needed a diagnosis - and then precise corrections applied in the right order.

One profile. Fixed right. That is what we do.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipOJy3mh_mri89p58ff1GIb1nYg3fZZPZcennsXb=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": "Call now", "posted_at": "2026-09-21T12:45:20", "expires_at": "2027-03-23T12:45:18", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "2847217073987226698", "text": "Thirty-one impressions a month. Zero inbound calls from search. Eleven weeks of silence on a profile the owner thought was in good shape.

The business was a marketing agency serving clients across Brooklyn and the wider New York metro. The profile looked fine - the numbers told a different story. A competitor that had opened roughly two years prior was ranking above them for the same terms. The owner had typed seo services near me into Google and found that newer agency sitting in position two. Their own listing did not appear on the first page at all.

The audit found two problems. The primary category was set to "Advertising Agency" - accurate enough on the surface, but not how their best clients were searching. There was also a NAP mismatch across three major citation sources, which was quietly suppressing local rankings without triggering any visible warning on the profile itself.

Visible in theory, invisible in search. That was the situation.

Four weeks of fixes: category corrected, citations aligned, profile sections completed. Within six weeks, impressions climbed from 31 to 740. Calls from search went from zero to eleven in a single month.

[{"id": "9062630922787711930", "text": "Introduction To Digital Marketing
So, you have the perfect domain name, a solid host for your website, engaging and well-crafted content and a feature-rich website ready for business. Now what?

A website isn’t going to magically bring customers to you, yet to be successful, your site needs visitors. Let’s look at various ways you can attract visitors to your new website and what to do when you get them there.

 

Search Engine Marketing (SEM)
Search engine marketing is the practice of marketing a business through paid advertisements that appear on search engine results pages (SERPs). Advertisers are able to bid on keywords their potential customers may be using in their searches when looking for certain products or services. The highest bids get the better placements.

The thing that makes SEM such an effective tool in digital marketing is that it offers advertisers the opportunity to put their ads in front of customers who are already motivated to buy. No other advertising medium can do this, so it’s no wonder SEM is such a powerful way to grow your business. Another positive is that you only pay for the ads when they’re clicked on. This is called a pay-per-click (PPC) system for that very reason.

 

Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
A website isn’t going to magically bring customers to you, yet to be successful, your site needs visitors. [{"id": "9036029891555852922", "text": "Running a small business is challenging. 💼 You wear many hats, and gaining online visibility can feel overwhelming. This is where AEO — Answer Engine Optimization — becomes a game changer. 

AEO helps your business appear when customers ask questions on search engines, voice assistants, and AI tools. Instead of chasing keywords, you become the direct answer. For small businesses, being that answer is vital.

Here is why AEO matters:
✅ Customers find you faster when it counts.
✅ It establishes your business as a trusted, reliable source.
✅ It drives long-term visibility beyond just paid ads.

At Thump Local, we know every small business deserves the chance to thrive. AEO is a practical step to ensure that growth. You do not have to navigate this alone; consistent, small steps lead to significant results.

What is one challenge your business faces regarding online visibility? We would love to hear from you. 👇

TikTok marketing is the practice of using TikTok to promote a brand, product or service. It can include different tactics, like influencer marketing, TikTok advertising and creating organic viral content.

Increase brand awareness
Build engaged communities
Sell products and services
Get feedback from customers and audiences

Advertise products and services to target audiences

TikTok influencer marketing

Customers then try to justify the purchase with logic. So, since emotions instigate sales, copy has to evoke emotions.

If a customer has a problem that needs solving or a desire for a particular item, they're going to feel a wide range emotions before, during and after a sale. I sounds crass, but business copy needs to leverage these emotions.

🏆 Which one would you put on a luxury car? Tell us your pick and why! 👇

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipO7k2ZDsxYgA6GnKDKCEJ2YJzCkEs9Mjsqd_kwa=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-09-21T14:03:05", "expires_at": "2027-03-23T14:03:03", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "6823594376554879838", "text": " 🤖 "Use AI! It'll make your life easier."


Also 🤖: "Wait… does this look AI-generated?" 😂


We've gone from encouraging AI everywhere to treating it like a writing crime scene.


At this point, just write like a human. Or at least make it look like one. 👀.


", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMsiLaHXyenIpM968bU0sBaYn1u8qF4ElfW3O0L=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-09-18T14:02:53", "expires_at": "2027-03-20T14:02:52", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "3596296118615419629", "text": "🎤 What does a concert tour have to do with marketing?

More than you might think.

Advertising puts the tour in front of you.
Promotion gets you excited about the experience.
Publicity gets the media talking about major moments.
PR builds positive relationships and stories around the artist.
Sales turns that excitement into tickets, merchandise, and action.

And marketing?

Marketing is what brings it all together.

Because a successful tour isn't built from one song—and a successful marketing strategy isn't built from one tactic.

Every piece has a role. The magic happens when they work together. 🎶

👉 What part of your marketing lineup could use more attention? 
", "type": "update", "image": null, "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-09-16T15:06:32", "expires_at": "2027-03-18T15:06:32", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "3514210999506909565", "text": "🙋🏻‍♂️ Your opinion could help shape the next brand!

Precious Cargo is a transportation company based in Missouri, offering services for spouses, caregivers, foster parents, and court-appointed supervisors.

🚗 We explored different logo directions for the brand—now we want to know which one you would choose!

👇 Which logo is your favorite?

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPvcR9oux-MwMOLFOnDe2l-jDlAxG7lreKv1hxv=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-09-14T14:02:19", "expires_at": "2027-03-16T14:02:17", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "8386306330414414921", "text": "📺 Ever used a product and thought: "Who designed this thing?!" 😂

Sometimes the problem isn't the product… it's the organization behind it.
When teams don't communicate, customers can feel every gap. 👀

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipNA05Jzq3huJ5WZIOYGEJwdFJRhG-41_7B8H_UR=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-09-11T17:15:10", "expires_at": "2027-03-13T17:15:08", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "4481484591490062606", "text": "Your website can look amazing and still lose customers. 👀

Sounds contradictory, right? But we've all experienced it. You land on a website that looks impressive… and then you can't figure out where to go, what the company actually offers, or how to contact them.

So you leave.That's the problem with treating a website as a design project instead of a business tool. Good design matters. 🎨

But your website also needs to be:
📱 Easy to use on mobile
 🧭 Simple to navigate
 💬 Clear about what you offer
 👉 Focused on the customer's next step

Every unnecessary click creates friction. Every confusing section creates doubt. And every moment a customer spends trying to understand your website is another opportunity for them to choose someone else.

💡 Here's a simple test:

Open your website on your phone and pretend you've never seen your business before.
Can you understand what the company does in a few seconds? Can you find what you need? Can you easily figure out what to do next? If the answer is no, the problem may not be traffic. It may be the experience you're giving the traffic you already have.

A website shouldn't just look good. It should make doing business with you feel easy. 🚀


", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipN2gBk-Vh9lV33_fr6cgEvlu9me-R3EEoafI_6t=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": "Call now", "posted_at": "2026-09-09T17:15:18", "expires_at": "2027-03-11T17:15:17", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "6784895614864144129", "text": "💪🏼✨ Where health, wellness, and innovation come together.

For eHealthGo, we explored different visual directions inspired by fitness, modern healthcare, and holistic well-being.

🏋️‍♂️ Which logo feels like the best fit for the brand? Let us know your favorite below! 👇


", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipNG3o50CSJr56fGIPENZrsr0NcNoEcP8kii1KDU=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-09-07T17:18:10", "expires_at": "2027-03-09T17:18:09", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "4788353199540467725", "text": "😂 SEO used to be about getting to page one.

Now Google might just answer the question without sending anyone to your site. 😅
The rules are changing fast. 
What worked yesterday might not even matter tomorrow.

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipNQqNXrFzRa-ymti31N31YCuY0ye7D-oir_Au3l=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-09-04T15:01:58", "expires_at": "2027-03-06T15:01:57", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "16801185782838119", "text": "Your website might be the first conversation your business has with a potential customer. 👀 And unlike a salesperson, your website can't explain itself if something is unclear.


That's why a professional website needs to do more than look good. It needs to answer the questions customers are already asking:

[{"id": "7403535860658970198", "text": "Our mission for this project was to highlight María Trusa’s digital presence – a resilient woman who, despite childhood adversity, embraced empowerment to not only achieve her personal goals but to uplift others. 

The outcome? We developed a multilingual website designed to resonate with Maria’s diverse audience, seamlessly integrating her message of resilience and empowerment. Our strategy focused on promoting her personal projects, including:

✅ Podcast: Agency-led and executed, boasting over 60,000 listens
✅ Book sales: Available in physical hardcopy, digital, and audiobook formats in two languages, designed and produced by our team
✅ Events: Conferences, galas, and lectures also organized by Primitive.

Additionally, we created a timeline showcasing Maria’s journey, celebrating each milestone since she embarked on her inspiring mission. 💡 

At Primitive Agency, we are passionate about collaborating on projects that make a positive difference in people’s lives and contribute to a better world. ✅ Fidelización: Las publicaciones periódicas crean una expectativa entre los lectores. Si tu contenido es bueno, esperarán con ansias cada nueva edición, aumentando la lealtad hacia tu marca.

[{"id": "8998848914409448716", "text": "AI does not need to create the content to change influencer marketing.

Some of its biggest value is behind the scenes, helping teams move faster through research, creator selection, campaign management, reporting, and optimization.

The result? Less operational friction and more time focused on the creative and strategic work that actually makes campaigns successful.

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipOn5rMZTAQwKHSdjdcbl_PPmmbOYo-I1s4PXDuS=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-08-31T19:09:41", "expires_at": "2027-03-02T19:09:40", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "2985746405002555341", "text": "Influencer marketing has become a major growth channel, but scaling it requires more than increasing creator volume.

The brands that succeed will be the ones building the infrastructure behind the partnerships: better workflows, clearer processes, and stronger measurement systems.

Creator strategy gets attention. Operations create scale. If you want to learn more, check out our website

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipP23akQ_oNQCpTeWiVuVpH7D0ZXG59XxsIS5tLR=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-08-21T16:18:09", "expires_at": "2027-02-20T16:18:08", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "7171804117859392802", "text": "The creator with the biggest audience is not always the right creator for the campaign.

Strong influencer marketing starts with alignment: the right audience, the right values, and the right ability to influence action.

Finding creators is easy. Finding the creators who truly fit the brand is where strategy matters.

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipNAMWfYAq2DvbzyBYpzk0iJln7PRUdzJwxEzMNG=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-08-19T21:15:43", "expires_at": "2027-02-18T21:15:41", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "7165439631190712677", "text": "The strongest influencer partnerships start with better talent selection.

At HireInfluence, creator recommendations are built through a hand-vetted process that evaluates content quality, audience fit, engagement, demographics, past partnerships, authenticity, and brand alignment.

For brands that already have strategy and execution resources in place, our Talent Team can support the process by curating premium-fit influencer options designed to match the campaign objective.

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipP-DTeKDyY-japW1QXv9L0QrQgOgun5U2_mUoro=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-08-13T16:12:14", "expires_at": "2027-02-12T16:12:13", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "5211969991495020719", "text": "A viral post can create attention, but attention does not automatically create growth.

Without a repeatable system behind it, a spike can disappear as quickly as it arrived. The stronger strategy is consistent content, intentional testing, clear audience direction, and the ability to turn winning ideas into formats that keep working.

The brands that grow are not just chasing the lucky post. They are building the system that makes momentum easier to capture when it happens.

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipOiKKKWVLZjauGHHVIFGpXRfoF008GZmR792RbD=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-08-10T20:55:22", "expires_at": "2027-02-09T20:55:20", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "5891497316508788515", "text": "Influencer marketing is becoming more performance-driven, and that shift is changing how brands choose creators.

Reach still matters, but it is no longer the main indicator of campaign value. Brands are looking more closely at audience fit, conversion potential, customer acquisition cost, average order value, and whether creator content can move people closer to purchase.

That is one reason micro-creators are gaining more attention. Their communities may be smaller, but they often bring stronger trust, more focused influence, and better alignment with specific buyer groups.

The future of creator marketing is not just bigger audiences. It is smarter partnerships, better measurement, and content built to support real business outcomes.

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPrqwh4tuYVYqHLIUkbSrPvDc-wUVNhmbr-IdJN=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-07-29T19:11:24", "expires_at": "2027-01-28T19:11:23", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "512424961629499950", "text": "Influencer performance is strongest when creator credibility and paid amplification work together.

Daxton Bennick’s campaign performance shows how one creator can drive both organic engagement and scalable paid reach. Across paid and organic activity, the content generated 1.4M impressions, 402.7K reach, and a 10.07% engagement rate.

For brands, the lesson is clear: creator content should not be treated as a one-time post. When the content resonates, strategic amplification can turn that momentum into measurable campaign impact.

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipNDZr6SMyOZUyQNS6ZXFIyNbzW8MM3GD4PH_2rH=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-07-22T19:50:40", "expires_at": "2027-01-21T19:50:38", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "1692801281282294282", "text": "The strongest campaigns today are not driven by reach alone. They are built around ", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMK7RDnJ0fQpQ2yaj9M24t-unEXfwpVC8-nrm8K=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-07-15T16:08:04", "expires_at": "2027-01-14T16:08:03", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "8629502332035748751", "text": "The right influencer partnership starts long before content goes live.

Follower count can show scale, but it does not guarantee trust, relevance, or performance. Strong creator selection looks at audience alignment, brand fit, content standards, engagement quality, and the signals that suggest a creator can influence action.

That level of vetting helps protect brand equity, strengthen campaign performance, and ensure every partnership is built with intention.

It is a foundational part of the HireInfluence process.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipOfuYOa6RwLkMtcYUPLKYUeZ-rMnq5rNLyLo8v5=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-07-13T20:12:10", "expires_at": "2027-01-12T20:12:08", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "8129579469511659215", "text": "Christina brought Fresh’s Rose Deep Hydration story to life through floral artistry, turning the product’s hero ingredient into an elegant, sensorial creator moment.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMJIWpogVZUE_FN9qjYYxYdr4hHJLsNL3qIrp1h=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://hireinfluence.com/contact/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-06-26T18:20:52", "expires_at": "2026-12-26T18:20:51", "promo_code": null}]

[{"id": "5809317390579004046", "text": "Is UX design dying? The short answer to this is a vehement no. Sure, the web design world has had a few wild years as far as user experience (UX) goes. However, some design trends that seemed inconsequential a few years ago have now become rather big. Given that design trends are evolving rapidly, there’s a need to analyze them in relation to your business and its online presence.

As the digital era takes over all industries, you need to understand the importance of getting a professional website to represent your business. This begins by looking at the top UX design trends that are set to change the digital landscape in the coming years.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPTP-nVqLPEKmSPI3gmTqIyJ_zdq7eSyZru4nyz=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.topnotchdezigns.com/top-ux-design-trends/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2023-12-29T00:49:41", "expires_at": "2024-06-29T00:49:37", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "513790243491790922", "text": "A number of people are unsure of whether they should opt for responsive or mobile web design when optimizing their websites for smaller screens. The truth is that while both make sure your website is available to people using devices with small screens, they have their pros and cons. By going through this responsive web design vs. mobile site comparison, you may determine which one might work better for you.

Mobile website designs have been in use for a while but responsive design is slowly taking over, mainly because this new-age concept comes with a number of benefits that are not present in traditional designs. As you manage your website, the design you select will have a significant impact, which is why you need to choose carefully. The best way to make an informed decision is to understand what each option has in store for you.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPl-DGhKgg3I6WB2eI06j1iZ-df1ZhEU_mC0XVp=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.topnotchdezigns.com/mobile-website-design-vs-responsive-web-design/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2023-12-21T02:27:50", "expires_at": "2024-06-21T02:27:43", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "4613350392385136793", "text": "People place an enormous amount of trust in banks, given that banks are responsible for handling their finances. As a result, in today’s high-paced tech-driven world, it is important for banks, credit unions, and other financial institutions to have user-friendly websites that focus on reliability.

If you look at the best bank website designs, you will notice that they all fare well when it comes to maintaining brand consistency across design elements, having prominent calls-to-action (CTAs),  providing easy-to-follow steps, focusing on target audiences, and providing high levels of online security. Now, the design and functioning of a bank’s website is just as important as what you get to see and experience when visiting any of its physical locations.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPV8eK_MuHq7f7Co23wJWnZ1pjs6njxLLV75Jz3=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.topnotchdezigns.com/best-bank-website-designs-guide-to-boost-conversion/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2023-12-13T01:31:22", "expires_at": "2024-06-13T01:31:21", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "3818928153506449860", "text": "Websites function as the online representation and the foundation of the businesses they represent. They are important assets that website owners need to take care of and update based on changing requirements and technology. However, not all website redesign projects are smooth sailing, and if you’re wondering what are the common mistakes of website redesign, going through this post might work well for you.

Before delving into the mistakes, you ought to look at why a redesign is important. It’s common for businesses to redesign their websites because their visitors don’t find them attractive or interesting. In addition, while some businesses want to change their products or services, others want to present themselves in a new light. In any case, a redesign will give your website a fresh and improved look that will help attract more traffic and meet all the new rules set by search engines.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipM_hnOUqSz6uUnu5FUbYIUPU0tE1KvfRFAb825s=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.topnotchdezigns.com/10-big-mistakes-avoid-redesigning-website/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2023-12-07T00:42:11", "expires_at": "2024-06-07T00:42:08", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "3808146707858344111", "text": "Chances are you’ll run into a web designer or a web developer no matter where you go, be it on a train, in a bar, or at the golf course. However, do you know what these terms mean? Can a person be both, and how is one different from the other?

Given the widespread confusion about these terms, you’ll find people looking for web designers when they actually need web developers, and vice-versa. This has been a hot topic for several years because most people don’t really understand the roles these professionals play in building a website. If you’re wondering which of the two you might need, going through this web developer vs. web designer guide might work well for you.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipO0Eeedn9LyAZoOhyD5PnnjIZlCZcAeDRik_cCv=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.topnotchdezigns.com/web-developer-vs-web-designer-differentiate/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2023-12-03T13:44:40", "expires_at": "2024-06-03T13:44:40", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "8494162844734014637", "text": "While most web designers follow different styles, there are a few elements that draw a line between the mediocre and the best. The intricacies are not secrets, and while most designers know what the process entails, the manner in which they implement what they know is different. Understanding the factors that the best website designers in the world take into account can be important if you want your website to deliver the desired results.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPvqbC9FrWwRGhi_O98ce9zDz6qvLqPcjhc4Vrt=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.topnotchdezigns.com/best-website-design-company-world-focus/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2023-11-22T00:50:05", "expires_at": "2024-05-23T00:50:04", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "1992506694735748383", "text": "After online marketing became a growing trend, finding a website design company was easy. Data indicates that around 10,000 people in the U.S. offered web development services at the turn of the last century. In 2023, this number stands at approximately 1.2 million. With the plethora of options from which you get to make a selection, it’s only fair to wonder how to choose a website design company. Fortunately, making the right choice is not as difficult as you might imagine, and all you need to do is pay attention to a few simple factors.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPflWX6wQ2oQDWVTKvdNkQbNMQNnoFR7Mqdm2LN=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.topnotchdezigns.com/8-steps-choose-web-design-company/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2023-11-06T06:26:14", "expires_at": "2024-05-07T06:26:14", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "8571461282016591177", "text": "If you have a website, you’ve probably heard about search engine optimization (SEO) because it has remained a hot topic for a rather long time. A simple explanation is that it is the practice of structuring and writing web content with the aim of improving rankings on search engine results pages (SERPs). However, how much do you know about local SEO? If you run a business that caters to an audience from a particular geography, whether a neighborhood or a city, it’s important that you understand local SEO basics and look at the benefits on offer.

Now, an increasing number of people use their mobile phones to search for businesses in their vicinity. This is the case even if they’re not interested in making online purchases. If you have no plans to optimize your website for local search, there’s a good chance you will lose out on a lot of potential customers. Employing a good local SEO strategy, on the other hand, can help you move past your competition.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipM6BQDSvT6ZB3Tx5tENkKH52Iuz105Oapcs_W1p=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.topnotchdezigns.com/local-seo-basics/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2023-11-01T02:11:44", "expires_at": "2024-05-02T02:11:43", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "4503437048706931753", "text": "Most people do not understand crawl budget fully, which is why it’s important to learn how to optimize it for the best possible results. When website owners and managers think about SEO, what typically comes to mind is a list of factors that help in ranking, such as keywords, clean sitemaps, impressive designs, proper use of tags, and fresh content. However, an important aspect that many people overlook is the crawl budget.

Here, you get to look at the relationship between crawl budget and SEO. You also get to learn how to optimize crawl budget.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPrfhMix7p3OzThTVF9kQlUgagH8kgP6e2gz8fX=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.topnotchdezigns.com/9-tips-optimize-crawl-budget-seo/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2023-10-27T06:25:27", "expires_at": "2024-04-27T06:25:26", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "923081870445018420", "text": "Digital marketing has transformed the landscape of various industries in recent years and real estate is no exception. The market is developing in such a way that buyers may no longer have to physically assess properties before making their final decisions. This is all thanks to digital marketing. 

Undoubtedly, the Internet has revolutionized advertising. These days, local newspapers and billboards are no longer the standard for advertising property. Digital marketing in real estate creates better publicity by showcasing property listings to a global audience. Additionally, certain digital innovations allow prospective buyers to thoroughly inspect houses without having to set foot in them. This eases the burdens of the seller/agent and the buyer alike. Suffice to say, digital marketing doubles as a savvy real estate agent.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMaWWMJ1n_eNe5YthoEoxRa01mERG29hXv4HKAz=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.topnotchdezigns.com/all-you-need-to-know-about-digital-marketing-for-real-estate/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2023-10-19T06:06:50", "expires_at": "2024-04-19T06:06:49", "promo_code": null}]

[{"id": "8206890722591763363", "text": "The story is the strategy. Every brand has something to say — but the ones that break through know how to say it, when to say it, and to whom. That's not luck. When the message is spot on, it's excellent PR. 🔴

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipN5Snu5Hi0WAHJyCqDLR5ybG38SCkNyQBHN_Z3n=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.bpm-prfirm.com/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-04-09T18:43:24", "expires_at": "2026-10-09T18:43:23", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "3259912931778844845", "text": "🚀 PR Tip: The best PR campaigns have a built-in reason for the media to care.

Too many brands launch campaigns that are essentially just… announcements.

A strong PR campaign should give journalists multiple angles to cover, not just one headline.

Think about layering in:
• a data study or original survey
• a partnership or collaboration
• a cultural moment or trend tie-in
• an event, activation, or stunt
• expert commentary from leadership

When a campaign creates several story opportunities, media outlets can approach it from different perspectives — which multiplies coverage.

Great PR campaigns aren’t one story.
They’re a collection of stories built around one idea.

Call us today to launch your PR campaign at 1.877.841.7244 or email info@bpm-prfirm.com

", "type": "update", "image": null, "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-04-09T16:47:32", "expires_at": "2026-10-09T16:47:31", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "1579199822328694564", "text": "🎯 PR Tip: Investors invest in leadership as much as the company

Your executive team should already be visible in the media as:
• industry experts
• thought leaders
• credible voices on market trends

PR builds familiarity — and familiarity builds trust when it’s time to raise.

Because investors don’t just back ideas.
They back people they’ve seen, heard, and trust.

Need immediate PR? Contact us at info@bpm-prfirm.com
 or call 1.877.841.7244

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipOr3f-Aft3z2ileh-pEeCuPIn-xDWA2umBwFKTT=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.bpm-prfirm.com/investor-relations-pr/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-04-02T15:02:07", "expires_at": "2026-10-02T15:02:05", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "4767458792213190164", "text": "Getting into Sephora, Ulta, or Target is the goal. Staying in — and selling through — is the strategy.

Most beauty brands have a plan to get on the shelf. Almost none have a plan to stay there. That's where brands get quietly discontinued.

The shelf doesn't sell the product. The story does. And the story is built through PR — before launch, on launch day, and every month after.

Swipe for the 4 PR strategies that get beauty brands into major retailers and keep them there. 👉

📖 Full article at bpm-prfirm.com → link in bio
📩 info@bpm-prfirm.com · 1.877.841.7244", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPpXFNkhWMfgC_cTJBjfpM6oAsncpetJSJzJ4HH=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.bpm-prfirm.com/getting-into-sephora-ulta-and-target-why-retail-expansion-requires-pr/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-03-26T17:15:23", "expires_at": "2026-09-25T17:15:22", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "4512308773108802637", "text": "🔁 PR Tip: Silence between funding rounds kills momentum

Consistent PR keeps your company:
• top of mind for future investors
• relevant in your industry
• positioned for the next round

Momentum in PR signals momentum in business.

Need immediate PR? Contact us at info@bpm-prfirm.com
 or call 1.877.841.7244

[{"id": "8206890722591763363", "text": "The story is the strategy. Every brand has something to say — but the ones that break through know how to say it, when to say it, and to whom. That's not luck. When the message is spot on, it's excellent PR. 🔴

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipN5Snu5Hi0WAHJyCqDLR5ybG38SCkNyQBHN_Z3n=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.bpm-prfirm.com/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-04-09T18:43:24", "expires_at": "2026-10-09T18:43:23", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "3259912931778844845", "text": "🚀 PR Tip: The best PR campaigns have a built-in reason for the media to care.

Too many brands launch campaigns that are essentially just… announcements.

A strong PR campaign should give journalists multiple angles to cover, not just one headline.

Think about layering in:
• a data study or original survey
• a partnership or collaboration
• a cultural moment or trend tie-in
• an event, activation, or stunt
• expert commentary from leadership

When a campaign creates several story opportunities, media outlets can approach it from different perspectives — which multiplies coverage.

Great PR campaigns aren’t one story.
They’re a collection of stories built around one idea.

Call us today to launch your PR campaign at 1.877.841.7244 or email info@bpm-prfirm.com

", "type": "update", "image": null, "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-04-09T16:47:32", "expires_at": "2026-10-09T16:47:31", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "1579199822328694564", "text": "🎯 PR Tip: Investors invest in leadership as much as the company

Your executive team should already be visible in the media as:
• industry experts
• thought leaders
• credible voices on market trends

PR builds familiarity — and familiarity builds trust when it’s time to raise.

Because investors don’t just back ideas.
They back people they’ve seen, heard, and trust.

Need immediate PR? Contact us at info@bpm-prfirm.com
 or call 1.877.841.7244

Most beauty brands have a plan to get on the shelf. Almost none have a plan to stay there. That's where brands get quietly discontinued.

The shelf doesn't sell the product. The story does. And the story is built through PR — before launch, on launch day, and every month after.

Swipe for the 4 PR strategies that get beauty brands into major retailers and keep them there. 👉

National Association of Realtors
Class of Action Lawsuit Settlement

 Buyer agent compensation: Buyers are now responsible for paying the buyer
agent's compensation.
 Written agreements: Real estate agents must have buyers sign a written
agreement before showing them a home. This agreement should include the
terms negotiated with the agent, the services and value that will be provided, and
how much the agent will be compensated.
 MLS compensation offers: Compensation offers are no longer allowed on
Multiple Listing Services (MLS), which are local marketplaces used by real estate
professionals to share information.
 Commission rates: Online MLS databases no longer display commission rates.

Buyers moving forward:
1. The buyer must hire their agent.
2. Buyers must sign an agreement, pay their commission. (Most of the times seller
will still offer the buyer agent compensation, Buyer can finance their agent
commission by using seller concession if not offer by seller, If none of that work:
The buyer must pay on the closing.

Seller Moving Forward:
1. Seller can decide to pay only their agent only ( It will hurt them because all other
agent on MLS ( Over 40,000 agents) won’t send their client the property, the
other agents on mls won’t work to sell the properties, the property will get less
exposure which will cause the property to sell at lower prices.

Class of Action Lawsuit Settlement

 Buyer agent compensation: Buyers are now responsible for paying the buyer

 Written agreements: Real estate agents must have buyers sign a written
agreement before showing them a home. This agreement should include the
terms negotiated with the agent, the services and value that will be provided, and
how much the agent will be compensated.
 MLS compensation offers: Compensation offers are no longer allowed on
Multiple Listing Services (MLS), which are local marketplaces used by real estate
professionals to share information.
 Commission rates: Online MLS databases no longer display commission rates.

will still offer the buyer agent compensation, Buyer can finance their agent
commission by using seller concession if not offer by seller, If none of that work:

1)	SEARCH ENGINE RANKING
Regularly posted blogs refresh your website, as opposed to having it appear dormant. It may not be practical to update the well-crafted Search Engine Optimized (SEO) pages of your site, but keyword-embroidered blog posts will keep your website active – and impact favorably with search engines.

2)	SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT
Blogs provide useful material for posting and sharing on social media sites, helping to place your company in the spotlight.

Blog pages may rank higher than some “Home” pages during online searches, drawing potential clients or customers to the blog – and ultimately to other areas of your website, where they may be further engaged.
