[{"id": "4995360591013831069", "text": "What is PPC? 
Pay-per-click (or PPC for short) is an online digital marketing technique that allows advertisers to buy visits (or clicks) to their website. With pay-per-click methods, advertisers bid for ad placements in a search engine’s sponsored links section, and they then pay a small fee for every time one of their ads gets clicked on by a user. In other words, PPC is the opposite to organic traffic generation (through SEO for example).  When somebody searches a keyword related to the advertiser’s business, their ad will appear as the search engine’s top result. But the advertiser pays for that privilege – and each time the ad is clicked by a potential customer – a small fee is exchanged with the search engine. With a successful PPC strategy, the fee is usually negated by the increased profits that advertisement space generates. After all, forking out $2 per click is certainly worth it if it leads to an advantageous sale. A successful PPC strategy is about much more than paying a search engine, however. It requires a well-thought-out strategy based on keyword organization, ad groups, and highly optimized PPC landing pages that draw in – and hold onto- potential customers. And that’s where eCommerce PPC management comes into the picture. A PPC management team will ensure that your store’s ads and landing pages are user friendly and built to generate profits for your business.

When we look at SEO in more detail, there are three distinct parts to it. These parts are:

Quality of traffic. 
This means you want to attract the right visitors to your website, or, in other words, the visitors who will use your legal services. In simple terms, you do not want visitors on your site who are actually looking for something else.

Quantity of traffic. 
Once you get the right people visiting your site, it is always better to have more of them.

Organic results. 
Online ads like pay-per-click ads make up a significant part of many search engine results. Organic traffic, in contrast, is any traffic that you do not have to pay for. It brings visitors to your site purely on where you rank in the search results. 

SEO works because search engines use crawlers that gather information about all the websites on theInternet. These crawlers then build an index of these websites and an algorithm then tries to match all that data with your query.

[{"id": "265584586111028046", "text": "Four founders — Putnam, Walker, Dunn and Gelman — built four unrelated products: a game table, a craft school, a social app, a murder-mystery inn. All four landed on the same answer: people want structured ways to spend time together in person.

When separate founders reach the same conclusion from different starting points, it signals a real shift in what people want. We help businesses build spaces and experiences designed around bringing people back into the room.

Source: TechCrunch", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPWSKl2NZiAU3PQGl0zo0rbtisJcL6YYzSqohL1=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/20/a-small-but-growing-number-of-founders-are-betting-that-bringing-people-together-is-its-own-industry/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-21T00:48:27", "expires_at": "2027-03-23T00:48:26", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "4518691686109898258", "text": "When Putnam's household grew from three people to seven, she stopped building for solo focus and started building for shared connection. Her first product, Mirror, was designed around one person's fitness routine. Her next, Board, was designed to bring a full house together.

We find the shift itself instructive: same founder, same skills, entirely different problem to solve. Understanding what someone actually needs technology to do changes everything about how you build it.

Source: TechCrunch", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipNuRc1wF-pCURnQ-uUHz6vPF8LNHoDE4cRUqfWx=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/20/a-small-but-growing-number-of-founders-are-betting-that-bringing-people-together-is-its-own-industry/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-21T00:28:32", "expires_at": "2027-03-23T00:28:30", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "5579576348185354257", "text": "Audrey Gelman's first company, The Wing, shut down after criticism over how it treated staff. TechCrunch reports her newest venture is a countryside inn that runs staged murder-mystery dinners, and guests reportedly leave trading phone numbers well past midnight. We read that as proof that the idea behind The Wing, getting strangers to connect in person, survived the shutdown and just changed shape. For anyone building a business around face-to-face gathering, it's a useful reminder: a company can fail without the demand behind it disappearing. See how other founders are testing that same bet on real-world connection.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMOqMx2EfFKJI53wWdryvZUuk8EarQK4kKqMYd1=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/20/a-small-but-growing-number-of-founders-are-betting-that-bringing-people-together-is-its-own-industry/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-20T21:30:00", "expires_at": "2027-03-22T21:29:59", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "6663224772825258303", "text": "Bugatti went dark for almost 50 years: no factory, no new cars, just history books. When Volkswagen brought the brand back, it didn't bolt a production line onto an existing plant — it rebuilt the factory on the exact original site.

We think that decision says everything about what reviving a legacy brand actually takes: not the name, the process behind it. See how few hands it takes to build one car today.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPVM1hwOWEeaL-t5-u1sgnhkDF2cjgoIVHgeriq=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://amworldgroup.com/blog/bugatti-builds-one-car-at-a-time-by-hand-with-twenty-people-heres-what-that-actu", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-18T14:28:28", "expires_at": "2027-03-20T14:28:26", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "8066830166127813137", "text": "In 1948, David Ogilvy opened his advertising agency at age 38 with no ad copy experience, no track record, and four small, unglamorous clients. Before that he had been a cook, a door-to-door salesman, and a farmer. He was, by most measures, unqualified.

What he didn't have in credibility, he made up for in discipline. The lack of big-name clients meant he couldn't coast on reputation. The lack of a track record meant every piece of work had to earn its keep. Those constraints, not raw ambition, shaped the approach that eventually built one of the most respected agencies in the industry.

We think about this often in our own work. It's easy to assume that success comes from starting with the right resources, connections, or experience. Ogilvy's story is a reminder that limits can sharpen focus in ways comfort never does. Small clients forced attention to detail. No reputation meant results had to speak for themselves.

We wrote up the fuller story of how Ogilvy turned those early constraints into a lasting method, including the one unfashionable idea that guided his approach from the very beginning. [{"id": "3514578122815067629", "text": "There is a pattern in SEO that repeats itself every few years. A technical feature gets introduced for a legitimate, narrow purpose. Then a wave of consultants, agencies, and self-proclaimed optimization experts start treating it like a ranking superpower. Clients get sold on it. Everyone adds it everywhere. Then the signal either gets devalued, abused into irrelevance, or quietly deprecated. We watched it happen with meta keywords. We are watching it happen right now with schema markup.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipO7f6dU3ucOtcWkYKMjhKXqfX1_pNzF2I0s2y6M=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.marketing1on1.com/schema-markup-is-the-new-meta-keywords-tag/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-07-30T18:00:00", "expires_at": "2026-12-23T18:15:33", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "7497460691905093950", "text": "Most SEO Companies Are Full of It - Here’s What Actually Moves Rankings.

We’ve seen it a thousand times. An SEO agency walks into a client meeting armed with jargon, metrics, and acronyms. They discuss entities, semantic optimization, schema markup proliferation, and contextual relevance scores. They promise the moon. They deliver mediocrity. Meanwhile, we’ve watched ranking victories happen with none of that noise.

The reality? Most SEO professionals use complex terminology as a smokescreen. As someone once said, “Stupid people use complex terms in an attempt to sound smart.” That quote hits different when you’ve spent years cutting through the BS in this industry.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipP1R0ZlMVsAJXZW6XN3fqJNhd_W7ouvHhLrv3C2=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.marketing1on1.com/most-seo-companies-are-full-of-it-heres-what-actually-moves-rankings/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-07-29T21:00:00", "expires_at": "2026-12-17T00:58:15", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "3762163995170704765", "text": "Google Ads are a Ripoff Scam and are Optimized to Waste Your Money.

Your Google Ads budget is bleeding out through “close variations” that aren’t close at all. Despite setting exact match keywords, Google shows your ads for completely unrelated searches. The platform prioritizes clicks over relevance. Your carefully planned campaigns burn through cash on worthless traffic. This systematic waste isn’t accidental - it’s designed to maximize Google’s revenue at your expense.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipO_FTWHVvcP0kGJZz0GNjlBMXaJL9cXBpk7A4j7=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.marketing1on1.com/google-ads-are-a-scam-and-are-optimized-to-waste-your-money/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-07-28T21:00:00", "expires_at": "2026-12-17T00:56:00", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "6048264338344525048", "text": "Outsourcing SEO overseas for pennies? Here’s why it can wreck your rankings.

You’ve seen the pitch. A company in India or the Philippines offers to handle your SEO for a fraction of what domestic agencies charge. They promise the same results. They swear they follow best practices. The price tag makes your accountant smile. Here’s the truth: you’re about to learn an expensive lesson about the difference between cost and investment.

The SEO industry has a dirty secret. Price and quality don’t live in the same neighborhood. In fact, they often live on opposite sides of the tracks.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPZ-o3MDO1VO-OLMO0Ws_GKhWkgIEZ-F1obW-bA=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.marketing1on1.com/outsourcing-seo-overseas-for-pennies-heres-why-it-can-wreck-your-rankings/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-07-24T20:00:00", "expires_at": "2026-12-17T00:54:35", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "4710432447937639682", "text": "Old School SEO Is Dead: Why Cheap SEO Budgets No Longer Work and What Real Digital Competition Looks Like Now.

There was a time when you could hire someone for $300 a month, have them build a handful of directory links and stuff a few keywords into your meta tags, and actually rank. Those days are gone. Not fading – gone. The SEO landscape has fundamentally restructured itself around authority, distribution, and multi-platform presence in ways that make the old playbook not just ineffective but genuinely counterproductive.

At Marketing 1on1, we work with businesses across industries and competitive markets every day. What we see consistently is a massive gap between what business owners expect SEO to cost and what it actually takes to compete in today’s environment. That gap is getting wider, not narrower. Understanding why is the first step toward building a strategy that actually moves the needle.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipP3bvPX6gElyLmcGJ4DlDOzNma-NpolVshhuUVF=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.marketing1on1.com/old-school-seo-is-dead-why-cheap-seo-budgets-no-longer-work/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-07-23T20:00:00", "expires_at": "2026-12-17T00:49:58", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "5685069417528806043", "text": "Why Free Online Website SEO Reports Are Mostly Garbage.

Those free SEO report tools promising to reveal all your website’s problems? They’re basically worthless. Most generate scary-looking reports filled with red flags and critical errors designed to panic you into buying their services. They rarely check your actual keyword rankings or analyze real performance metrics that matter.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMGneB_KiYWi73cd1nGm6ZyoJ-KWsYHPbyeWCBC=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.marketing1on1.com/why-free-online-website-seo-reports-are-mostly-garbage/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-07-21T19:30:00", "expires_at": "2026-12-17T00:34:36", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "1271757352123483646", "text": "Why AI SEO Tools Don’t Work and a Waste Of Money.

You’re probably throwing money at AI SEO tools hoping they’ll magically fix your rankings. I get it. I spent over $10,000 on these tools these year. Every single one failed miserably. These tools can’t understand your actual business needs, they generate generic recommendations that hurt more than help, and they definitely can’t replace real SEO expertise. Let me save you the heartache and empty wallet by showing you exactly why AI SEO tools are the biggest scam in digital marketing right now.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipOVk7oo-b4QsLr7hv8yYszW_WRWnnR2JEoh-irv=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.marketing1on1.com/why-ai-seo-tools-dont-work-and-a-waste-of-money/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-07-20T19:30:00", "expires_at": "2026-12-17T00:32:47", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "882855388614223314", "text": "Schema Markup for AI Optimization Didn’t Improve AI Rankings or LLM Citations.

For the past couple of years, schema markup has been positioned as one of the more actionable levers SEOs can pull to improve their visibility in AI-generated answers. The logic seemed reasonable: if you give AI systems cleaner, more structured data, they should be able to understand and cite your content more confidently. It made intuitive sense – until a large-scale controlled experiment put that assumption directly to the test.

Ahrefs ran that test. They analyzed over 6 million URLs, ran a matched difference-in-differences analysis over 30 days, and examined citation behavior across AI Overviews and AI agents. What they found doesn’t completely invalidate schema as a practice, but it does dismantle a very specific and widely held belief about why schema supposedly helps AI visibility.

We’ve been tracking developments in AI search optimization closely at Marketing 1on1, and this study is one of the more rigorous attempts to separate signal from noise in a space that desperately needs it. Let’s break down what the study found, what it missed, and what it actually means for your SEO and AI optimization strategy going forward.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipM431_GATYV41WxTNbwF0py7AIhEu6UvD8ablBP=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.marketing1on1.com/schema-markup-for-ai-optimization-didnt-improve-ai-rankings-or-llm-citations/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-07-17T21:30:00", "expires_at": "2026-12-17T00:31:17", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "717712980652073415", "text": "AEO & GEO AI Optimization: Breaking Down Google’s Official Recommendations.

Google has finally published its official stance on AEO, GEO, and what website owners should actually be doing to show up in generative AI search experiences like AI Overviews and AI Mode. For anyone who has been wading through the noise of AI optimization theories, vendor pitches, and half-baked “strategies” floating around the SEO community, the guide is a breath of fresh air – and, honestly, a bit of a gut punch to some very popular advice.

We’ve read the guide in full, cross-referenced it against our own testing, and looked closely at the recent Ahrefs study analyzing schema markup’s actual effect on AI citations across 6 million URLs. What we found reinforces what we’ve suspected for a while: most of what’s being sold as “AI optimization” is either redundant with good SEO, completely ineffective, or actively misleading.

Here’s our full breakdown of Google’s guidance, what it actually means in practice, and where we agree, disagree, or have additional data to bring to the conversation.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipNuJJt6PDWiLRPjaSJFJOxObTNzdsXZdu5FczE0=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.marketing1on1.com/aeo-geo-ai-optimization-breaking-down-googles-official-recommendations/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-07-15T23:00:00", "expires_at": "2026-12-17T00:26:54", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "8322147691778616945", "text": "The Brutal Truth: Why Perfect On-Page SEO Still Won’t Rank You on Page 1

If you’re a law firm looking to understand what really moves the needle in legal marketing, tune in below.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipNLKTG1PaqinCFwc8tdjskl_KZQOlsZB8RMiavB=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.berbay.com/news/building-visibility-credibility-revenue-through-public-relations-megan-braverman-interviewed-on-judicial-dollars-and-cents-podcast/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2026-09-16T16:10:03", "expires_at": "2027-03-18T16:10:02", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "2849478841987477649", "text": "Distributing your press release via a newswire can look a lot like earned media coverage – but looks can be deceiving.

For LA firms, the right media coverage positions attorneys as trusted authorities and keeps their expertise in front of clients, prospects and referral sources.

Berbay knows the legal and business reporters who cover Los Angeles, and how to translate complex legal work into stories that earn attention. We handle the strategy, outreach and follow-through to help firms build visibility and credibility.

✔ Identify any media, content or business development angles tied to the conference theme, location or audience. 

✔ Social amplification: announce participation on all social media platforms. 

The ROI from speaking rarely comes from the podium alone. It comes from everything you do before and after it.

[{"id": "4279375887661713343", "text": "Turn Listings Into Stories With Real Estate Video Marketing 🌴🎬

In a market as visually driven and competitive as Los Angeles, a standard property walkthrough video is no longer enough to impress high-net-worth buyers. Buyers in this city aren't just looking for a floorplan; they are buying into a lifestyle, a neighborhood, and a dream.

If your marketing simply lists the features of a home, you are failing to capture the emotional connection required to secure top-dollar offers. At KPI Creatives, we help LA agents move beyond basic property tours and start crafting compelling visual narratives.

How we turn your listings into cinematic stories:
- Lifestyle Integration: We don't just film empty rooms; we capture the golden hour lighting, the flow of the space, and the quintessential LA vibe that makes buyers fall in love.
- The Neighborhood Narrative: A luxury home is defined by its surroundings. We use drone videography to tell the story of the property's location, views, and proximity to iconic local spots.
- Agent-Led Storytelling: We put you on camera to guide the viewer through the home’s unique architectural details, positioning you as the ultimate luxury property expert.
- Emotional Hooks: We pair high-end visuals with carefully selected music and pacing to ensure your marketing creates an emotional response before the buyer ever sets foot inside.

Stop settling for generic real estate media. Start telling stories that sell.

", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipM1fLUvBlWDkZe9epXFENj8AqOUzBdQceZz94CD=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2026-06-08T16:46:35", "expires_at": "2026-12-08T16:46:34", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "5105502138316166483", "text": "Video-First Social Media Marketing for Modern Brands 🎬🌴

In the heart of Los Angeles, static images and text-heavy posts no longer capture attention. The modern consumer’s feed is dominated by high-energy, engaging video content. If your brand isn't prioritizing a video-first approach, you are effectively invisible to your target audience.

Operating in the 90291 area, KPI Creatives understands that modern brands need modern solutions. We help Los Angeles businesses pivot to a video-first social media strategy that disrupts the scroll, builds deep community connection, and drives serious revenue.

Why a video-first strategy is non-negotiable:
- Algorithm Dominance: Platforms like Instagram and TikTok heavily prioritize video. We create the exact format these platforms want to push to thousands of local users.
- Rapid Trust Building: Putting your team, your process, or your products on camera instantly humanizes your brand and builds trust faster than any graphic ever could.
- Higher Conversion Rates: Dynamic video content explains your value proposition clearly and quickly, leading to higher engagement and more frictionless conversions.

Abandoned shopping carts.

If these three words make you uncomfortable or perhaps a little anxious, you’d want to read this article.

Building an eCommerce website involves meticulously following a long list of steps and processes to deliver the best shopping experience for website visitors. But no matter how much effort you invest into building the perfect website, shopping cart abandonment and keeping visitors longer are persistent problems that have troubled online retail businesses forever.

In our two decades of experience as an eCommerce marketing agency, hundreds of businesses have fretted over low conversion rates due to shopping cart abandonment. And we have helped startups, marketplaces, and eCommerce behemoths ace that challenge with our expertise, skill, and technical nous. Today, we want to help you do the same with that very trifecta.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipNruIB2_pK24B29XYuDD_8FLOkO2yQ5dPLN_9IM=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://marketingrevive.com/blog/digital-marketing/12-powerful-ways-to-reduce-shopping-cart-abandonment/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2023-02-06T12:01:09", "expires_at": "2023-08-08T12:01:08", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "8369719699553901571", "text": "The Ultimate Guide To Increase Instagram Engagement By Using IGTV

Are you looking for a way to double or triple your monthly customer engagement on Instagram? If so, then you’ll want to start focusing on video, which is quickly emerging as the most crucial medium in online marketing. The video makes up one-third of all online activity, so you need to find a way to use it to your business’s advantage. Luckily, there’s an exciting new platform called IGTV video Instagram that lets you do just that.

[{"id": "6728043450375918861", "text": "SMS marketing isn’t a new concept but it can be a powerful tool to keep in your wheelhouse! SMS stands for “Short Message Service”. It is a great tool for increasing brand awareness, boosting engagement from customers and generating more sales! It offers a unique touchpoint for interacting with your consumers and is a great way to help build the relationship. Here are 5 SMS marketing ideas: 📱
-----------------
1. Exclusive SMS Offers - Send your consumers a well-timed and exclusive offers! 😃
2. Competitions/Giveaways - Incentivise consumers with giveaways and exclusive competitions  🎉
3. Feedback Surveys - It's a great way for gathering consumer data 🗳
4. Cart Abandonment - don’t overdo it but consider reaching out initially for a follow-up reminder 🛒
Bonus:
5. Order confirmation and shipping dates - empower your consumers with the option of getting SMS updates and notifications 📦
6. Birthday, Anniversary, Holiday discounts  🌲
8. Special time-sensitive offers - Have a promotion going on? Let your customers know  ⏰", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMgOZtfU_nRmGu7pRmYT6ufmsWD-0Ta9DV91VEC=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2020-02-07T00:11:15", "expires_at": "2020-08-08T00:11:15", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "94452502393884738", "text": "Monopoly is the condition of every successful business. 🏙️ If your industry is in a competitive equilibrium ⚖️ the death of your business won’t matter to the world; some other undifferentiated competitor will always be ready to take your place. - Peter Thiel", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPX2DJTDCFg-6IzEwhOLCilP2zFq6_o9PRNYlrG=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2020-02-03T22:20:13", "expires_at": "2020-08-04T22:20:13", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "1457688019576781517", "text": "Ezra Firestone of @SmartMarketer made some interesting points on what he calls “Golden Handcuffs” 🤲 He asked the question, “Are we conditioned to chase money?” this was his answer:
-----------------
He suggests optimizing your life around whatever it is that brings you the most pleasure instead of chasing instagram fame or money is so much more internally rewarding. You’ll have a much better life if you are focused on having a good time, even if part of having a good time includes your production cycle that makes you money. Everybody has to eat but that cannot be your only agenda in life. Money has no intrinsic value, it’s something we trade for things we think are valuable. 😃
------------------
If you are overworked, underworked out and aren’t spending enough time with friends and family are you really optimizing your life for success? This is what Ezra considers “Golden Handcuffs”, wealth creation is a great game to play but not when it comes to the detriment of these other key areas of your life. 👪
-------------------
Life is full of stimuli, there is so much advertising and conditioning that is selling us on the idea that in life we should be chasing “success” and money. We are conditioned to think that the good stuff in life is the luxury vecheles, the clothes we are wearing and the vacations we are taking. We are sold the idea that success is more important than having fun.
--------------------
Optimize your life around what makes you happy!

[{"id": "3730621609838828685", "text": "🦷 Are you still burning your marketing budget trying to rank for "Dentist Los Angeles"?

[{"id": "1592643439376872416", "text": "Engagements with Gen Z Creators Across the Country
Gen Z has become a huge part of the consumer culture. When we like a product, we stick to it and tell everyone we know. We have such a major influence on the market and advertising.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipOV5yhf6JpMpAoP_W64ua6hy9KdyBzbqwNJScM=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://adolescentcontent.com/engagements-with-gen-z-creators-across-the-country", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2023-07-26T21:25:17", "expires_at": "2024-01-25T21:25:17", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "4487862031436079024", "text": "Why is Messaging So Important in Content?
As the only generation that has had internet access since birth, Gen Z interacts differently with the real world, the digital world, and with content and branding. Older generations have been more malleable in what they believe and in the content they consume, but we’re not so easily swayed. In fact, Gen Z questions everything. Content must be created at a very truthful level for us to buy in.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipMSd9srvCRymUbTEDDGFO_LyIUpP8ThlDc_yCs=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://adolescentcontent.com/why-is-messaging-so-important-in-content", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2022-12-20T22:36:05", "expires_at": "2023-06-21T22:36:04", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "5526907103923182335", "text": "Who is Adolescent Content? 
 We build relationships with GENZ! 
Adolescent’s research & insights division, Youthtellers develops strategy that helps reach GenZ. Adolescent’s production company produces large and small productions at scale and has an amazing roster of talented directors and photographers as well as a global network of over 4,000 Creators in twenty different countries.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipPniywulpIyz29a02TvfhbQqGmJ5k4p3wvkEVE=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://adolescentcontent.com/about", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2022-12-05T22:25:45", "expires_at": "2023-06-06T22:25:45", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "9075679687907375557", "text": "How Adolescent Content Builds Relationships with Gen Z -
Gen Z has already forged a new relationship with almost everything. With social media. With connections. With the world. And with brands. The reality is that Gen Z isn’t like former generations, even Millennials. And how we interact with the world requires a new level of understanding and relationship building.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipM2fV4YgfDlQOkyDGt8gOgO565pQJuTV9Ffr2g=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://adolescentcontent.com/how-does-adolescent-build-relationships-with-gen-z", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2022-11-22T14:03:46", "expires_at": "2023-05-24T14:03:46", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "1304156969947361996", "text": "How to Understand Gen Z Humor -
Unless you’re constantly online, venturing onto the internet can be fairly daunting. The memes, jokes, videos, and slang resident to the internet can feel like they’re in a completely different language; for many people they’re the epitome of gibberish. Gen Z, however, is fluent in this language.", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipOAs_tMaPH7H6da2X94ttd_2wazcZdRqW9cGww=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://adolescentcontent.com/how-to-understand-gen-z-humor", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2022-11-18T22:13:46", "expires_at": "2023-05-20T22:13:46", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "5845691004819615291", "text": "Gen Z's Influence on the World -

[{"id": "1256099227071119394", "text": "An open letter to our community; words cannot express how we are feeling nor can we fully grasp the feeling our neighbors/partners/friends of color go through every single day. What we do know is that we are here to support you. Lift you up. Be a voice and a platform for change. We will continue to celebrate diversity in the workplace. We will use our social channels to share resources applicable to the cause, this also means shifting our 'Small Talk Series' towards sharing stories of those affected by recent events. 

But...

Now is not a time to be silent!

The task for businesses right now isn't to attempt to predict what's going to happen, it's to experiment. Nobody truly knows what's around the corner. But right now, we all have permission to experiment.

We can do this together!

Thank you,

The Bruxton Team", "type": null, "image": null, "title": null, "cta_url": "https://www.bruxtongroup.com/contact", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2020-06-09T17:21:22", "expires_at": "2020-07-07T17:21:22", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "3471199298259561844", "text": "New website, who dis? [{"id": "7606160112929275816", "text": "Quick trip to Vegas to hang out with the Idolsgang and VTO boys at Trucks & Treats before the hectic Wynn Resorts Concours and Specialty Equipment Market Association (SEMA) schedules hit. While we were there, we shot Mike's sick Gen 1 Raptor...I think we got some cool BTS. 👀", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipOt_Ikms7-zpNEpNxV5fdU5g-0rxUnKI5AI7lLg=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://mkgdirect.com/", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2025-10-14T17:09:25", "expires_at": "2026-04-15T17:09:12", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "6927879375814602265", "text": "Another day, another off-road shoot in the books. Always a good time at Cleghorn OHV. Wrapped up a super fun shoot last week with three sick Toyota FJC's tearing it up.

Special thanks to the crew who brought their rigs and weren't afraid to get them dirty for the perfect shot. This is what the off-road community is all about. Passion, performance, and pushing boundaries.

PS: our little Subie does so good on these trails, we're probably going to modify it some more...🤠", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipM84cZZIJZiUypkDtCyCNd2n456j3_DR8qXm2Ut=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": null, "cta_label": null, "posted_at": "2025-06-18T22:50:20", "expires_at": "2025-12-18T22:50:19", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "9214781950128647389", "text": "Prélude du Printemps unfolds a tapestry of renewal and rebirth, guiding you through spring's transformative, and sometimes chaotic journey with carefully curated sounds that inspire growth. 🌱

🔊 Hit the learn more button below to listen:", "type": "update", "image": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc/AF1QipN0Pcdy0CtO_yeM6sOdU3BsHSmtFLKdKLbAWDZU=h400-no", "title": null, "cta_url": "https://open.spotify.com/playlist/0IokeEvaowNXIQvE7fPbzN", "cta_label": "Learn more", "posted_at": "2025-04-02T16:46:14", "expires_at": "2025-10-02T16:46:13", "promo_code": null}, {"id": "6705008515536591588", "text": "The boys recently shot our Crosstrek (MKG-Mobile) on Lexani's latest tire, the Quattro Tempo All-Weather, up on ACH. Honestly? These tires took a beating during the shoot and held up surprisingly well in the wet, mud and even snow.

We're super happy with how the project turned out. We're a small team, but we get the job done, and we can't wait for the next shoot.

Side note, expect to see this little Subaru fitted with some more off-road goodies in the near future. The Black Rhino's are getting lonely. So far, the Crosstrek has been such a joy to drive and even keeps up with some of the big boys on the trails.

If you’re a first time property Buyer looking to purchase a duplex in Los Angeles, I’d be happy to help you understand the numbers and find a property that fits your goals.

Meta tags are one of the most important aspects of on-page SEO. They are pieces of information in the HTML of a web page that describe its content to search engines. Meta tags are very important when it comes to how search engines show your website in their results. This article will talk about the importance of meta tags in SEO, the different kinds of meta tags, and the best ways to use them.

What are Meta Tags?

HTML elements, known as meta tags, are used to describe web pages. They are not visible on the page itself since they are inserted in the HTML code’s head section. Its primary function is to inform search engines about the contents of a web page.

There are several different types of meta tags, each serving a different purpose. The most important ones are:

Title tag: This tag specifies the title of the page. It is displayed in the search engine results as the main heading for the page.

Meta description tag: This tag provides a brief description of the page’s content. It is displayed below the title tag in the search engine results.

Meta keywords tag: This tag used to be very important in the past, but most search engines no longer use it. It contains a list of keywords that describe the content of the page.

Meta robots tag: This tag tells search engines whether to index the page or not.
